releases.name: Project City
releases.summary: Drive, drift, hustle, and survive a city that reacts to every bad decision.

releases.name: Zumba - The Pharaoh's Marble Revenge
releases.summary:
Awaken the Pharaoh’s curse—match, blast, and conquer the sands of time!

Zumba – The Pharaoh’s Marble Revenge invites you into the golden age of Egypt, where a mystical scarab launcher guards the treasures of the ancients! Choose your path, aim enchanted orbs at winding desert tracks, and match three or more identical colors to trigger divine explosions before they breach the inner sanctum. Secure high scores and earn up to three stars per level by clearing waves with the precision of a master architect.
Between stages, spend your gathered gold to unlock powerful Egyptian relics:
Sunfire Flare: Scorches entire clusters with the heat of the desert sun.
Sands of Time: Slows the advancing orbs to a crawl.
Eye of Horus: Transmutes your next orb into any color you desire.
Anubis’ Rain: Summons a barrage of falling stones to create instant matches.
Obelisk Strike: Targets a single, stubborn orb for immediate destruction.
Eternal Echo: Undoes your last shot, offering a second chance at glory.
Journey through four legendary realms—the Verdant Nile Delta, the Gilded Giza Plateau, the Midnight Luxor Temple, and the Hidden Chamber of Duat. Every ten levels, the sands shift to reveal unique paths, new orb colors, moving obstacles, and escalating speeds.
Addictive and easy to learn but challenging enough to stump a Sphinx, Zumba – The Pharaoh’s Marble Revenge delivers timeless arcade fun for players of all ages.

releases.name: Palabras en ingles para aprender en la primaria
releases.summary:
Ready for first English words?

Can your child build English confidence one word at a time?

Words learned early can make school feel a little easier. This quiz game helps kids practice basic English vocabulary in a fun, low-pressure way.

How to play:
・Look closely at the picture
・Pick the matching English word from 4 choices
・Get it right to read a detailed explanation

releases.name: Therian Crush: Wild Animal Boys
releases.summary:
These guys are wild by nature. 
Get close, earn their trust, and unlock what they don't show just anyone.

releases.name: WordHive 3
releases.summary:
Build words, score points, and master the hive.

Word Hive 3 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you eight letters: seven outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all eight letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

Increase your score to climb the global ranks, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

Word Hive 3 uses an British English dictionary.

releases.name: The Golden Idol Saga
releases.summary: You have a spare minute? Employ your time usefully!Discover iGenius – the first combination of crosswords and scanwords in one application!Crosswords enrich your mind, train your erudition, and widen the scope of your knowledge. Pass your free time in a useful way and our charming assistant will help you in that.There is no need to leaf through enormous papers, to buy thick scanword magazines, correct the answers you have already filled in – just install iGenius! Every month you’ll get new crosswords and scanwords. The collections are automatically updated, so you’ll always have something to wreck your brain over.  Each issue contains 99 tasks of different complexity levels.iGenius features:-6 free levels-3 levels of complexity-3 color schemes-regular updates -iGenius gives you hints – one letter, one word or even a whole crossword. Use the hint if the situation is desperate.-If you’ve made a mistake, iGenius robot, your assistant, will help you find one.-Original music and iPod playlists supportSimple: just delete a word and enter a new oneInteresting: original, authors’ crosswords and scanwords.User-friendly: intuitive interface.The application is free. Each month new paid issues of crosswords and scanwords!

releases.name: GIRAFFE RAISING GAME ~Reach for the sky~
releases.summary:
This Giraffe's Neck Grows!

One day, while walking down the street, you encounter a mysterious, "neckless" giraffe?!
Upon closer inspection, it turns out to be a incredibly rare new species whose neck grows longer as time passes. And it seems to have taken a total liking to you!

Start your slow-paced, carefree life raising your very own special giraffe!

[How to Live with Your Giraffe]
■ Keep an Eye on Its Belly!
Your giraffe’s fullness meter drops over time. Keep it happy and healthy by feeding it carrots so it never goes hungry!

■ Harvest Piles of Carrots in Mini-Games!
Carrot Tower: A balancing game where you stack carrots as high as you can. The higher you stack, the bigger the reward! But watch out—drop just one, and it's game over. Stay focused and aim for a high score!

Carrot Darts: Aim carefully and throw carrots at the target. Show off your skills and go for the gold!

■ Shop Till You Drop! ♪
Exchange your collected carrots for handy items in the shop. Get your hands on useful goodies like Mini-Game Tickets or a Name Tag to give your giraffe a name, and deepen your bond together!

releases.name: Escape game R00M16
releases.summary:
Explore 3D space and escape

Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.

releases.name: Research Story
releases.summary:
Tame creatures, grow crops, and record your findings!

Discover and record 90+ plants, creatures, and fish at various locations around Shimmerbrook, and contribute your findings to the Archive.

Features
- Tame and raise 32 unique creatures
- Observe wild plants and grow them as crops based on different requirements
- Meet over 20 townsfolk, attend town festivals, go on hangout events
- Date and marry one of the 10 romanceable candidates
- Dig deep into the mines, fish, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery behind Shimmerbrook
- Cook, craft, build, and more!

Your life as a researcher starts today!

releases.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Baekje Military Museum
releases.summary:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone.

There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3.

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Baekje Military Museum, Korea with "Real" footage!

releases.name: Court of Darkness: Adoration's Kiss
releases.summary:
In this world of magic, your kiss is an irresistible temptation.

The long-awaited third installment in the Court of Darkness series is finally here!
Experience brand-new romance storylines with a fresh cast of consorts♪

■Story
The night of a crimson crescent moon,
you find yourself transported
to a realm called Saligia.

Far removed from your everyday life,
you're in a world where magic is commonplace.

In the midst of your confusion,
before you appear
five beautiful princes.

They crave the power
your kiss can bestow,
and will scheme to get it.

But what they seek
is not just your power.
They want your heart as well...

releases.name: Magnetail
releases.summary:
Get ready to enter a world of clever inventions, smart challenges, and brilliant solutions in Magnetail. In this charming puzzle adventure, you follow an ingenious inventor mouse who transforms workshops, laboratories, and storage rooms into playgrounds of experimentation and discovery.

Each level presents a new challenge where energy, magnetism, and logic work together. Push energy modules, watch them slide across the environment, and use magnets strategically to redirect trajectories, create barriers, and open unexpected paths. It may seem simple at first, but you will quickly discover that every move can completely change the outcome of the puzzle.

The key is thinking several steps ahead. Where will the module stop? Which magnet should be used first? Which route leaves the path clear for the next move? In Magnetail, every decision matters, and finding the perfect solution is as satisfying as powering up a complex machine for the very first time.

Explore 30 carefully crafted levels spread across busy workshops, experimental laboratories, and storage facilities filled with mechanical challenges. New situations constantly emerge, requiring observation, planning, and creativity to master the rules of magnetism and turn obstacles into opportunities.

With charming visuals, accessible controls, and puzzles that reward intelligence and experimentation, Magnetail delivers a relaxing, engaging, and highly rewarding experience. It is the kind of game that makes you stop, study the room for a moment, and then smile when the perfect solution finally clicks into place.

Align the modules, master the magnets, and prove that no invention is too complex for a brilliant mind.

releases.name: Chew Chew Mimic
releases.summary:
Play as a hungry mimic in this head-scratching puzzle game where you have to guide unsuspecting knights to their doom.

Lay down traps to get all the knights to the mimic and try to collect each level's 3 coins for an extra challenge.

releases.name: Inside the Cube
releases.summary: Lost between endless rooms.

releases.name: A Taste of Home
releases.summary:
I broke the promise I made to my mother and went to visit a friend’s house. That was where it all began.

A short 3D exploration horror game set in a nostalgic Japanese countryside town.
Featuring multiple endings, with three different conclusions awaiting you.

●Story
Keita breaks his promise and visits a friend’s house while his mother is away for the day.

There, he begins to notice something unsettling about his mother.
A mysterious diary discovered at home… and the hidden secrets surrounding the house.

For some reason, his mother already knew that Keita had gone out to play.

And when she leaves again that night without returning, Keita sets out into the darkness to search for her...

releases.name: Cursed Objects: Find and Seal
releases.summary:
Can you spot the curse? Observe the scene Seal every object

Something is wrong at the scene.
Take a close look at the place where a strange phenomenon occurred, then figure out which cursed object caused it.

Check the objects that feel out of place and the visual clues left behind.
Read the situation carefully, trust your deduction, and choose the object behind the haunting.

How to play is simple!
・Observe the scene where the incident happened
・Look over anything suspicious or clue-like
・Find the cursed object you think is the cause and seal it

Even an ordinary-looking item may be hiding a secret that brings a terrifying phenomenon to life.

Use your observation and reasoning to uncover the truth one case at a time.
Each puzzle is quick to play, so you can think it through solo or talk it over with family and friends.

Recommended for players who enjoy:
・Ghost stories and uncanny tales
・Mystery games and visual puzzles
・Searching illustrations for tiny details
・Quick brain teasers in short breaks
・Solving spooky cases with family or friends

Can you see through the cause behind each strange event and seal every cursed object correctly?

releases.name: Crayon Story: Thumbelina
releases.summary:
An emotional, creative children's game where you color your own storybook and write your own tales.

Crayon Story: Thumbelina is a creativity-boosting game based on the classic fairy tale that children love. Beyond just playing, children can decorate scenes and complete stories in their own words, fostering a sense of accomplishment.


Key Features


Coloring: Touch the screen to fill scenes with vibrant colors. With intuitive controls, anyone can easily create their own masterpiece.


Writing: Write your own sentences to match the colored scenes. Your child's imagination brings a unique version of 'Thumbelina' to life.


Personal Gallery: Completed pages are saved in your gallery, so you can revisit and enjoy your custom storybook anytime.


Start a fun artistic journey with Crayon Story: Thumbelina by GaniTani!

releases.name: Monst
releases.summary:
Devour and destroy the world. Fighting against armed forces with various transformations. Obtain energy, numerous weapons and abilities.

Players take on the role of an alien monster, devouring and fighting against human armed forces with various transformations, and annihilating the world. By continuously devouring humans to obtain energy, numerous weapons and abilities can be added to combat human armed forces and eliminate the world. When encountering different extraterrestrial crystals, one can acquire different superpowers. And it can have different transformations in different situations, experiencing super destructive power.

This is a Roguelike game where players operate an alien monster to devour humans, obtaining dozens of weapons, shields, and more through the energy gained Buff、 Follow the ball, fire different energy bullets, and merge these bullets for firing. Different follower balls can also attack in different ways.

In the game, there are randomly encountered alien crystals that can acquire different superpowers, providing abilities such as freezing, fire breathing, and protective shields, making the game process more interesting.

In the game, you can also have different transformations and experience super destructive power. If it can transform into a super ape with invincible power, it can directly destroy houses and police cars in the city.

releases.name: Vanishing Evidence: Mystery Cases
releases.summary:
Can you erase every clue?

Can you spot the trace that should never be left behind?

In this mystery puzzle game, you clean up evidence left at a scene and help turn a risky case into the perfect cover-up.
You are not the detective. You are the fixer hired to erase the evidence.
Read the prompt, study the illustration, and find the piece of evidence that needs to be removed.

How to play:
・Read the case prompt
・Observe the illustrated scene
・Select the matching evidence

Choose the right evidence, and the scene changes as that trace is cleared away.
Look closely for visual clues, suspicious details, and odd inconsistencies, then recover anything that could work against your client.

Each case has its own situation and request.
Think through what should be erased in each scene, using observation and deduction to make the call.
Since each question is self-contained, it is easy to play in short sessions while still enjoying a satisfying mystery.

Recommended for fans of mysteries, deduction, illustration-based puzzles, and quick brain-teasers.
Collect every piece of evidence and lead the case into the unknown.

releases.name: Therian Crush: Wild Animal Girls
releases.summary:
They're wild, and they know it. Answer their questions, survive their challenges, and unlock something worth the wait.

Half girl, half wild animal, and completely out of your league. The Therian girls are untamed, unpredictable, and they've got their eyes on you. Keep up with their pace or get left behind.

Answer their questions in fast Q&A rounds while defending against reflex attacks in minigame battles.

Every right answer, every level cleared, brings you closer to unlocking exclusive images in their private gallery.

Each girl has her own personality, her own instincts, and her own way of testing you before she lets you in.

Do you have what it takes to earn the trust of a wild heart?


Features:

● MECHANICS THAT PUT YOU TO THE TEST: Q&A and reflex-based minigames trade off without warning. Answer smart, react fast, and keep moving.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Clear levels to unlock new images in each girl's personal gallery. The more you progress, the more they reveal.

releases.name: Ghetto Zombies: Graffiti Squad
releases.summary:
Ghetto Zombies is an intense pixel art action shooter where you take control of different heroes from an elite squad to face hordes of zombies and eccentric creatures.

Armed to the teeth with quirky weapons - like ketchup pistols, bubble gum launchers, and water guns - you'll explore a chaotic city, showcase your art with graffiti, defeat challenging bosses, and hunt for the cure to the epidemic!

releases.name: Hidden Photo Mysteries: The Truth Gets Scary
releases.summary:
What doesn't belong in the photo?

A plain black-and-white photo... until something from the future seems to be sitting right there.

People holding objects that should not exist in the era when the picture was taken. If time travel has already been developed somewhere beyond our knowledge, why did these visitors choose these moments to appear?

Follow the clues hidden in each eerie scene and trace the truth behind the photo. The more you understand what is wrong, the closer you get to a chilling answer.

・Read the scenario for the scene
・Study the black-and-white image carefully
・Select the piece of evidence that feels out of place
・Check why that clue leads to the truth

Even a normal-looking photo can turn unsettling once you notice the detail that should not be there. Perfect for fans of urban legends, mystery puzzles, slow-burn horror, and solo brain teasers.

Take your time, look closer, and see if you can uncover the truth behind the picture.

releases.name: Dungeons of Alethrion
releases.summary: Dungeons of Alethrion is a dungeon crawler roguelike game based on the Youtube animated series, Tales of Alethrion. Play as epic heroes from the show, each with unique abilities. Play it alone or grab a friend to join you in the dungeons!

releases.name: IQ Logic Codes: Number & Letter Puzzles
releases.summary:
Can you crack the pattern? Train logic in quick rounds

Think a simple set of numbers or letters is easy to read?

Those familiar-looking patterns can turn tricky once the hidden rule is just out of sight.

This is a text-based 4-choice logic puzzle game where you observe the question, spot the rule, and choose the answer that fits.

There are 40 stages to clear, built for quick brain-training sessions with number, letter, and reasoning-style challenges.

How to play is simple!

・Read the question carefully
・Look for the hidden rule or shared pattern
・Choose one answer from four options
・Check the explanation after answering

Even when you miss, the explanation helps you see the logic and try the next puzzle with a sharper eye.
